recommended_scope.language: English prompts and answers; language hints require review for short, code, mixed-language, and translation cases

quota_note: Approximately preserves the full reasoning_off turn ratio; not claimed to be the English-only subset ratio.
deduplication: At most one record per normalized first-turn conversation input, also unique complete prompt; check exact prompt overlap with existing cleaned train and valid; flag near duplicates for review.
task_category_policy: Report semantic task coverage and inspect uncertain examples; no equal keyword-category quotas.
length_policy: No exclusion or truncation; record Qwen full prompt and target lengths, flag prompts over 10000 tokens.

quality_review.additional_review: All automated flags; expand review if problems cluster
quality_review.limitation: Not an exhaustive verification of factual correctness of all 1000 answers.

sampling: Deterministic random order without replacement within approved strata; quality rejects logged and replaced from same stratum.
output: Independent JSONL and Parquet plus provenance/lengths/reject log; do not merge into train or valid.
